why: The image copies the repository to /app with its .git intact (harness/Dockerfile, no .dockerignore), so /app is a real repository inside the container. repo_path is required on all twelve tools, so this server admits no argument-less call.
Bounded on purpose: an unbounded log on a large history is a slow call, and a slow call eats the driver's per-request budget for no extra information.
Reads a commit body, which is the largest payload this server produces. If a local server egresses, a diff is the thing worth noticing it egressed.
